notes: Product: VS Code copilot extension used by ~120 internal devs; goal: replace current local model inference to reduce infra ops
Primary ask: low-latency streaming completion (character-level), deterministic inline suggestions, and explicit model/version pinning per release
Latency target: median <= 50ms for incremental tokens in NA; p95 <= 150ms. Throughput: ~250 concurrent active editors during peak
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for dedicated capacity if it guarantees latency and rate limits
Auth / identity: require SSO (SAML) single tenant integration, SCIM not strictly required but desirable

Rate limiting: need per-editor and per-org throttles; want graceful backpressure (client-side fallback to cached suggestions) — 'if we get a 429 we should show cached inline suggestions instead of blocking', quote from CTO
Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified codegen or a forked open-code model; must support version pinning per extension release and atomic rollbacks
Fallback policy: prefer automatic fallback to a smaller quant model for burst traffic; must be configurable by route/model and observable in console
Data residency: logs and audit trails should stay in NA region for PII-sensitive repos; request options to disable persistent request logging for specific routes
Streaming behavior: incremental 'flush' granularity configurable (per-character vs per-token); need client SDK support for chunked websocket + HTTP streaming
